text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp
and the
start of a more rigorous
performance-improving
training routine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So this is the camp dorm... I just have
one
question.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is there an all-you-can-eat buffet here?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I haven't forgotten. And I know how
important it
is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I want to win all of my races, I'm gonna
have to
train hard.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm gonna go all-out. It's
just that...
food's important too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so marks the beginning of an
action-packed
summer camp with Oguri
Cap.
